SELECT id,display_name,category_id,category_name,pg_column_size(raw) AS raw_bytes,
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(k) FROM jsonb_object_keys(raw) k) AS raw_keys
      FROM public.carrefour_products WHERE (published IS TRUE AND (display_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)' OR category_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)')) ORDER BY id COLLATE "C" LIMIT 3
